name: Sandhamn
description: Sandhamn is an easy 8.1 km clockwise SAT loop from Sandhamn ferry quay on Sandön. It moves from the harbor village into sandy pine forest and open-coast beach terrain, with Trouville and other beaches, village heritage, and several seasonal food and lodging services close to the start/end. Treat services as strongly seasonal, and keep camping, fires, marina utilities and AEDs behind verification guards.
utilities: Primary public hiker utilities are the harbor public toilet/water at about [59.2879099, 18.9170226] and the mapped beach toilets at Trouville and Fläskberget.
KSSS guest-harbor water, showers, waste, fuel and electricity are marina/boat-guest infrastructure unless a later pass verifies free public hiker access.
Westerbergs Livs is the main village resupply candidate but requires Tempo-app/self-service access outside staffed hours.
Village food/lodging services are clustered near the ferry quay and should be rendered with strong seasonal/current-hours caveats.
waterSources: Primary refill: public harbor toilet/water at [59.2879099, 18.9170226], about 100 m east of Sandhamn ferry quay; SAT and OSM support 08:00-20:00.
Do not treat KSSS dock water as public hiker water: KSSS frames it as guest-harbor/desalination water with limited production and max 50 liters per boat.
Do not plan a Fläskberget refill. Only OSM currently tags drinking_water=yes there; local sources confirm toilets/facilities, not drinking water.
notes: Route shape: clockwise round trip on Sandön from Sandhamn ferry quay.
Sandhamn is the village and Sandön is the island; use both names carefully in descriptions.
The loop passes harbor village, sandy pine forest, exposed sea views, Trouville, Västerudden, cemetery/chapel context and back through the village.
Village-wide pilot/customs history is important context but is better represented by the Tullhuset/museum POI plus description text than by a separate no-coordinate POI.
Do not apply Blekinge/Karlskrona Sandhamn Natura 2000 SE0410225, Sandhammaren reserve in Skåne/Ystad, Gotska Sandön/Fårö facts or Svartkobben rules to the main SAT Sandhamn loop.

Draft-to-app mapping required: promote selected facilitiesDraft and pointsOfInterestDraft records during integration; pendingFacilityDraft, emergencyMetadataDraft and secondaryPoiDraft are not normal app-facing layers by default.
Do not expose the Google Drive officialGpxUrl directly as a runtime geometry source. Import/store the actual GPX/polyline artifact, and keep Google KML/PDF/Outdooractive as conflict evidence.

Keep low-authority or blocked/community links such as AllTrails, Wikivoyage, Trippa, Restaurants10, Cafekartan and Commons out of final user-facing citations when stronger official/operator sources exist.

facilities.name: Sandhamn harbor public toilet
facilities.description: SAT-confirmed public harbor toilet about 100 m east of Sandhamn ferry quay; OSM node matches closely. Keep distinct from KSSS marina services.

facilities.name: Sandhamn harbor drinking water
facilities.description: Primary hiker refill remains the SAT-confirmed harbor toilet/water node. Do not merge with KSSS dock water.

facilities.name: Trouville beach toilets
facilities.description: Route-side dry toilet at Trouville. OSM says no drinking water; Naturkartan supports nearby toilet availability.

facilities.name: Lilla Trouville toilet
facilities.description: Second mapped route-side dry toilet in the Trouville/Lilla Trouville area. Keep seasonal/verify caveat and do not treat Sandhamn.net or Naturkartan as confirming two distinct toilets.

facilities.name: Fläskberget toilet
facilities.description: Local sources confirm toilets at Fläskberget, but it is a short spur/near-route facility rather than directly on the SAT line. Treat OSM drinking_water=yes as guarded until non-OSM verification is found.

facilities.name: Westerbergs Livs / Tempo Sandhamn
facilities.description: Main grocery/resupply candidate in Sandhamn village, very close to the ferry quay.

facilities.name: Sandhamns Värdshus
facilities.description: Historic inn/restaurant/pub near Sandhamn village and the ferry quay.

facilities.name: Sandhamn Seglarhotell
facilities.description: Hotel with restaurants/bars/spa close to the harbor; useful as a service landmark but not a public trail utility.

facilities.name: Sands Hotell Bistro
facilities.description: Hotel/service candidate near the village/ferry area. Keep bistro-hour claims guarded until a live direct bistro page is verified.

facilities.name: Dykarbaren
facilities.description: Seasonal harbor restaurant/bar close to the ferry area. Use Destination Sandhamn publicly; the operator domain is retained only as tainted/internal research because iteration 5 found unrelated spam text in its live HTML.

facilities.name: Trouville beach
facilities.description: Signature southeast beach and major route anchor after the eastern/southern forest section; use as the primary beach POI.

facilities.name: Kvarnberget
facilities.description: Village-side viewpoint above the old shipyard; good cultural/nature viewpoint POI.

facilities.name: Västerudden / Västerudde strand
facilities.description: Western point and western-return route anchor before the cemetery/village return; keep primary because it helps structure the loop spatially. Coordinate follows the cited OSM Västerudden node.

facilities.name: Sandhamn customs house museum
facilities.description: Tullhuset and museum heritage cluster tied to Sandhamn's pilot, customs, fishing, hunting and smuggling history; use this as the main heritage marker instead of a separate no-coordinate pilot/customs POI.

facilities.name: Sandhamn cemetery and chapel heritage cluster
facilities.description: Cemetery and chapel heritage cluster on the village return. Render the cemetery as the primary pin because it is directly route-relevant; keep the chapel as child/secondary coordinate.
